title: Run-IQ proof input
description: The input of a decision in its canonical form (ProofInput), as accepted by validateProofInput from @run-iq/spec: what the input digest of a decision proof covers. The format is closed and every field is required; the reference date is meta.dates.effective (the former meta.effectiveDate is refused). Checks NOT expressible in JSON Schema, made only by validateProofInput: tags sorted by UTF-16 code unit without duplicates; lists of dimension values sorted by UTF-16 code unit without duplicates; no text or key holding a lone UTF-16 surrogate; no value nested more than 1000 levels below data or meta.context; no more than 10000000 values in all; no more than 268435456 UTF-16 code units in the JSON pointers of the leaves of the input tree, all added up (each scalar, list and empty object is a leaf, on each path that leads to it); a source subject with well-formed reserved segments (!group=<value>, !segment=<from>..<until> with real civil dates, from before until).

data.description: The facts, plain JSON. A root key starting with $ is reserved for the engine (D-3); deeper keys are free.

dates.description: The named dates (a name is non-empty, is not - and never starts with $, which is reserved); effective is the reference date of the decision. Each is a civil date or a canonical instant, never an offset (the caller normalizes first).

tags.description: The scope the caller chose: non-empty texts sorted by UTF-16 code unit without duplicates (sorting checked by validateProofInput only).

dimensions.description: A value, or a list of at least two values sorted without duplicates (sorting checked by validateProofInput only); a single value is written as a string. Names are non-empty and not -; names starting with $ are reserved.

context.description: Free JSON that rules do not read.

assertions.description: The provenance of facts, named dates and dimensions, keyed by the context pointer of what each covers: a fact (/revenue/total), /$dates or /$dates/<name>, /$dimensions or /$dimensions/<name> (a name non-empty, never starting with $), or '' for everything. A '-' segment is not an index and is refused.

jsonValue.description: Plain JSON; a number has an absolute value below 2^53 (D-5).

civilDate.description: A civil date YYYY-MM-DD that exists (proleptic Gregorian, years 0000 to 9999).

instant.description: An instant in its canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ.

dimensionValue.description: A non-empty code, or <system>:<code> with both parts non-empty.

assertion.description: Who established a fact, how, when and how firmly. source is required with method decision and refused with any other method.

complete.description: false on a collection that may miss elements; a list is complete by default, so true is never written.

source.description: The decision the fact comes from: its proof digest, the output it gave (qualified by its rule set unless local) and, for an output per element, the subject.
